# Candidate Assessment: DOC_resume_ninety vs. DOC_posting_ten_five

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | Resume Evidence | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages: Python | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Languages: SQL | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform: Linux administration | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Platform: Git | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Services: REST API design | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services: unit testing | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services: CI pipelines | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Infrastructure: all five listed | ✅ |
| 9 | Kafka | Streaming: Kafka | ✅ |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not listed | ❌ |

**Mandatory match: 9 of 10 = 90%**

Item 8 bundles five tools. If you count each tool separately, there are 14 mandatory skills and the candidate has 13 of them, which is about 92.9%. The only gap is the same under either method: **GraphQL**.

## Outcome

**Proceed.** The mandatory match is 90%, or about 92.9% counted per tool. Either figure clears the 85% threshold.

## Nice-to-Have

The resume shows none of the nice-to-have items (Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, public speaking). As instructed, this does not affect the outcome. It may still be worth asking about in an interview, along with GraphQL.
